description: Source code for a client application that communicates with the Emergency Access Daemon (EAD) over UDP, implementing authentication, command sending, and network communication.

methods.name: set_nonblock
methods.description: Sets the socket to non-blocking mode based on the enable parameter.

methods.name: send_packet
methods.description: Sends a packet of a specified type and handles responses with a handler function, with a maximum number of responses.

methods.name: prepare_password
methods.description: Prepares the password for authentication, applying MD5 hashing if configured.

methods.name: handle_pong
methods.description: Handles pong responses from the server, updating authentication state.

methods.name: handle_prime
methods.description: Handles prime/salt messages from the server, initializing cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: handle_b
methods.description: Handles B number messages from the server.

methods.name: handle_cmd_data
methods.description: Handles command data received from server, decrypting and outputting it.

methods.name: send_ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to discover devices.

methods.name: send_a
methods.description: Sends A number for key exchange.

methods.name: send_command
methods.description: Sends a command to the server, encrypting the message.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.
